## Problem

`public/llms/guides/how-to-sound-like-nick-augusto.md` presents a specific snare model as fact in 3 places, contradicting both the canonical root record and the guide's own direct source module.

- `api/drummers/index.js` and `packages/frontend/data/soundLikeGuides.js:13862-13867` (Nick Augusto's `gear.snare` object) both explicitly hedge: `model: 'Model not independently verified'`, `shell: 'Not independently verified'`, `"The specific model has not been independently verified..."`. This hedge was put in place by closed **#10443** ("soundLikeGuides.js hard-states fabricated 'Pearl Reference ... Brass' snare specs for Luzier/Augusto/Van Poederooyen/Wallgren").
- `public/llms/guides/how-to-sound-like-nick-augusto.md` was never regenerated after that fix and still states the pre-fix fact everywhere:
  - Line 19: `**Snare:** Pearl Reference 14" x 6.5" Brass`
  - Line 52 (gear table): `Pearl Reference 14" x 6.5" Brass`
  - Line 74 (FAQ): `...a Pearl Reference 14" x 6.5" Brass snare...`

This is a binding-rule-#2 (verified-only, omit-if-unsure) violation, same bug class as already-fixed #11187 (the `evolution/nick-augusto.md` mirror) — this is a different file in the `guides/` family that the earlier sweep didn't reach.

## Fix

Edit `public/llms/guides/how-to-sound-like-nick-augusto.md`:
- Line 19: change to `**Snare:** Pearl snare (specific model not independently verified)` — matching the wording already used for sibling drummer Ray Luzier in the same file family (`public/llms/guides/how-to-sound-like-ray-luzier.md:19`).
- Line 52: update the gear table row to the same hedged wording.
- Line 74: update the FAQ sentence to the same hedged wording.

## Verify

- `grep -n "Pearl Reference.*Brass" public/llms/guides/how-to-sound-like-nick-augusto.md` → no hits.
- `grep -n "not independently verified" public/llms/guides/how-to-sound-like-nick-augusto.md` → present in the snare section, matching `soundLikeGuides.js:13864-13867`.
- Cross-check the sibling fix pattern at `public/llms/guides/how-to-sound-like-ray-luzier.md:19` for exact wording consistency.

## Done

`public/llms/guides/how-to-sound-like-nick-augusto.md` no longer asserts an unverified snare model as fact; it matches the hedged wording already present in `soundLikeGuides.js`'s own Nick Augusto `gear.snare` object.
title: SEO: guides/how-to-sound-like-nick-augusto.md asserts unverified 'Pearl Reference Brass' snare as fact (pre-#10443 fix never synced)
